protocol.adaptation: none; frozen Qwen-warmed ensemble; no Gemma-12B training or calibration
protocol.cohort: first 128 fixed held-out IDs from translation study
protocol.human_controls: same article continuations as translation study, capped at 256 Qwen tokens
protocol.prompt_format: native instruction chat template, enable_thinking=False; identical English continuation instruction to Qwen study; assert exact tokenization with a single BOS
protocol.limitation: Generator transfer within news domain; original backbone pretraining contamination cannot be ruled out; 128 samples is a pilot.

mauve.protocol: Response-only Mistral final-token features, capped at 256 Mistral tokens, 25 buckets. Distributional proxy, not proof of preserved quality.
